name: JAC Sengoku ages probe: era length, era score sources, Lua API surface (read only, Japan 15 km, Takeda human)

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); if PlayerConfigurations[0]:GetLeaderTypeName()~='LEADER_JAC_TAKEDA_NOBUTORA' or PlayerConfigurations[1]:GetLeaderTypeName()~='LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE' then error('setup changed the configured players') end; HideGameSetup(); return 'setup built like Create Game (Takeda human, Oda AI)'

local out = {}
local pats = {'Era','Moment','Score','Commemor','Age','Property','Modifier','Boost','Dedic','Threshold','Loyalty'}
local function hit(k) for _, p in ipairs(pats) do if string.find(k, p, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
local function list(label, obj)
  local names = {}
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local mt = getmetatable(obj)
    local src = mt and mt.__index
    if type(src) ~= 'table' then src = obj end
    if type(src) == 'table' then
      for k, _ in pairs(src) do if type(k) == 'string' and hit(k) then names[#names+1] = k end end
    end
  end)
  table.sort(names)
  out[#out+1] = label .. (ok and '' or (' ERR:' .. tostring(err))) .. ' [' .. #names .. ']: ' .. table.concat(names, ',')
end
list('Game', Game)
list('Eras', Game.GetEras())
list('HistoryManager', Game.GetHistoryManager())
list('Player', Players[0])
list('PlayerCulture', Players[0]:GetCulture())
list('PlayerTechs', Players[0]:GetTechs())
return table.concat(out, '\n')

local lo, hi = 0, 10
local eras = Game.GetEras()
local out = {}
out[#out+1] = 'turn=' .. tostring(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()) .. ' era=' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEra()) .. ' eraStart=' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEraStartTurn()) .. ' minEnd=' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEraMinimumEndTurn()) .. ' maxEnd=' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEraMaximumEndTurn()) .. ' countdown=' .. tostring(eras:GetNextEraCountdown())
for pid = lo, hi do
  local p = Players[pid]
  if p and p:IsAlive() then
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
      local bd = {}
      for _, src in ipairs(eras:GetPlayerCurrentEraScoreBreakdown(pid)) do for k, v in pairs(src) do bd[#bd+1] = tostring(k) .. '=' .. tostring(v) end end
      out[#out+1] = 'p' .. pid .. ' ' .. tostring(PlayerConfigurations[pid]:GetCivilizationTypeName()) .. ' cities=' .. tostring(p:GetCities():GetCount()) .. ' score=' .. tostring(eras:GetPlayerCurrentScore(pid)) .. ' base=' .. tostring(eras:GetPlayerThresholdBaseline(pid)) .. ' golden>=' .. tostring(eras:GetPlayerGoldenAgeThreshold(pid)) .. ' dark>=' .. tostring(eras:GetPlayerDarkAgeThreshold(pid)) .. ' G=' .. tostring(eras:HasGoldenAge(pid)) .. ' D=' .. tostring(eras:HasDarkAge(pid)) .. ' H=' .. tostring(eras:HasHeroicGoldenAge(pid)) .. ' src{' .. table.concat(bd, ';') .. '}'
    end)
    if not ok then out[#out+1] = 'p' .. pid .. ' ERR:' .. tostring(err) end
  end
end
return table.concat(out, '\n')

local out = {}
local hm = Game.GetHistoryManager()
for _, pid in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5}) do
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local counts, order = {}, {}
    for _, m in ipairs(hm:GetAllMomentsData(pid, 0)) do
      local info = GameInfo.Moments[m.Type]
      local key = (info and info.MomentType or tostring(m.Type)) .. '@era' .. tostring(m.GameEra)
      if not counts[key] then counts[key] = {n = 0, s = 0}; order[#order+1] = key end
      counts[key].n = counts[key].n + 1
      counts[key].s = counts[key].s + (m.EraScore or 0)
    end
    local t = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(order) do t[#t+1] = key .. ' x' .. counts[key].n .. ' (+' .. counts[key].s .. ')' end
    out[#out+1] = 'p' .. pid .. ' moments: ' .. table.concat(t, ', ')
  end)
  if not ok then out[#out+1] = 'p' .. pid .. ' ERR:' .. tostring(err) end
end
return table.concat(out, '\n')
